description: This file defines the Scene class for managing graphical elements, including methods for element manipulation, selection, validation, and update handling within a drawing or diagramming application.

classes.name: Scene
classes.description: Class managing a collection of graphical elements, including their states, selection, and updates within a drawing application.

methods.name: getSceneNonce
methods.description: Returns the current scene nonce used for cache invalidation.

methods.name: getNonDeletedElementsMap
methods.description: Returns the map of non-deleted elements.

methods.name: getElementsIncludingDeleted
methods.description: Returns all elements including deleted ones.

methods.name: getElementsMapIncludingDeleted
methods.description: Returns the map of all elements including deleted ones.

methods.name: getNonDeletedElements
methods.description: Returns the list of non-deleted elements.

methods.name: getFramesIncludingDeleted
methods.description: Returns all frames including deleted ones.

methods.name: getSelectedElements
methods.description: Retrieves selected elements based on provided options, with caching.

methods.name: getNonDeletedFramesLikes
methods.description: Returns non-deleted frame-like elements.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves an element by ID.

methods.name: getNonDeletedElement
methods.description: Retrieves a non-deleted element by ID.

methods.name: mapElements
methods.description: Maps over all elements, applying a callback, and updates the scene if changes occur.

methods.name: replaceAllElements
methods.description: Replaces all scene elements with a new set, optionally skipping validation.

methods.name: triggerUpdate
methods.description: Triggers scene update callbacks and updates the scene nonce.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called on scene updates.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Clears all scene data and callbacks.

methods.name: insertElementAtIndex
methods.description: Inserts an element at a specific index.

methods.name: insertElementsAtIndex
methods.description: Inserts multiple elements starting at a specific index.

methods.name: insertElement
methods.description: Inserts a single element at its frame's index or at the end.

methods.name: insertElements
methods.description: Inserts multiple elements starting at the frame's index or at the end.

methods.name: getElementIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of an element by ID.

methods.name: getContainerElement
methods.description: Returns the container element for a given element.

methods.name: getElementsFromId
methods.description: Returns elements associated with an ID, including group elements.

methods.name: mutateElement
methods.description: Mutates an element with updates and triggers scene update if needed.
